offer.text: Dry weather and a spare hour — that is all a mould wants. Bring me eight bricks while the sky holds and they will set hard.

accept.text: Quickly, mind. I do not like that cloud.

decline.text: Sensible. It will rain before noon.

in_progress.text: While it is dry. Only while it is dry.

ready.text: Eight, and not a crack in them.

complete.text: Set them under the eaves. Good work.

failed.text: Rain. Of course it is rain. The moulds are slurry again.
